cards.hint: Think about different versus same alleles
cards.quote: If an individual has two different alleles at a specific locus, the individual is heterozygous at that locus
cards.stem: How is an individual described when the two alleles at a specific locus differ

cards.quote: if the two alleles are the same, the individual is homozygous
cards.stem: What term describes an individual when both alleles at a locus are the same

cards.hint: It reflects variation and richness in a group
cards.quote: Allele frequency is used to characterize the genetic diversity, or richness of the gene pool, in a population.
cards.stem: What does allele frequency help characterize about a population gene pool

cards.hint: Think of all alleles in a species group
cards.quote: A gene pool is the unique set of alleles that could be found by analyzing the DNA from every member of a species or population.
cards.stem: What is described as alleles found by analyzing DNA from every member of a population
